samples.summary: The share-token insert path still preflights the *untokened* stored URL through `loadImageDimensions`, which 403s for an anonymous visitor — so the upload succeeds but the insert aborts
samples.evidence: `insertImageFromFile` (packages/frontend/src/app/docs/image-insert.ts:100-107) does `const url = await upload(file); const {width,height} = await loadImageDimensions(url);`. For the new anonymous path `upload` is `shareTokenImageUploader`, which returns the deliberately token-free workspace URL `/api/v1/workspaces//images/` (image-insert.ts:42-47). `loadImageDimensions` (image-insert.ts:67-82) loads that URL in a bare `new Image()` — it does NOT go through the docs `setImageUrlResolver` seam this diff adds (that seam is applied only inside `getOrLoadImage`, packages/docs/src/view/image-cache.ts:57) and does not append the token. `ApiV1ImageReadController.assertCanRead` (packages/backend/src/api/v1/image-read.controller.ts:92-134) throws `ForbiddenException` when there is no user and no `?token=`, so the `` fires `onerror`, `loadImageDimensions` rejects, and the `catch` at image-insert.ts:109 shows "Image upload failed: Failed to load image: …" and never calls `editor.insertImage`. The primary acceptance criterion of the change (an anonymous editor-link visitor inserts an image) therefore fails; the fix belongs on the new code — the uploader/insert path needs the token appended for the probe (e.g. `appendShareTokenToImageUrl`) while still storing the bare URL.

samples.summary: Design doc's image-spine table now describes the old docs contract: it states `doc` uses only the unauthenticated `POST /images` spine and is "unaffected" by cross-workspace copy image loss
samples.evidence: docs/design/template-gallery.md:175 lists `doc` under the `postSharedImage` → `POST /images` row, and :181-182 asserts "`doc` is unaffected". After this change a doc can contain workspace-scoped image refs (`shareTokenImageUploader` → `/api/v1/workspaces/:wid/images/:id`), so `doc` now sits on both spines. (The copy path itself does handle it — `DocumentCopyService.copyContent` calls `rehostImages` for `type === 'doc'`, packages/backend/src/document/document-copy.service.ts:423-439 — so this is a stale document, not a broken behaviour.)

samples.summary: The /api/v1 route inventory in rest-api.md was not updated with the new anonymous write route `POST /api/v1/shared/images`
samples.evidence: docs/design/rest-api.md:448-450 enumerates the image routes (`POST/GET/DELETE /api/v1/workspaces/:wid/images…`) with no entry for `POST /api/v1/shared/images?token=`, even though the new controller is registered in `api-v1.module.ts:72`. `docs/design/sharing.md:103` was updated, so the inventory is now the only stale one. Likewise docs/design/backend.md:586's per-route throttle table lists the image routes at 600/min and omits the new 30/min route.

finding.summary: The share-token insert path still preflights the *untokened* stored URL through `loadImageDimensions`, which 403s for an anonymous visitor — so the upload succeeds but the insert aborts

verdict.reason: Code is exactly as described. `shareTokenImageUploader` (image-insert.ts:40-49) returns the deliberately token-free workspace read URL produced by the share upload controller (image-share-upload.controller.ts:107-115). `insertImageFromFile` (image-insert.ts:100-101) preflights that URL via `loadImageDimensions`, which uses a bare `new Image()` with no resolver and no `?token=` (image-insert.ts:67-82). The new docs resolver seam is applied only inside `getOrLoadImage` at render time (packages/docs/src/view/image-cache.ts:33,57) and via a layout effect on the shared mount (shared-document.tsx:900-915), so it does not cover the probe. The backend read route throws ForbiddenException for a caller with neither user nor token (image-read.controller.ts:114-133, guard at :41 is Optional auth), so the probe's fires onerror, the promise rejects, and the catch at image-insert.ts:109 shows a toast without ever calling editor.insertImage. The path is reachable for the feature's own acceptance scenario: SharedDocsLayout injects the share-token uploader (shared-document.tsx:331-334,360,367) into insertImageFromFile call sites (docs-formatting-toolbar.tsx:279, docs-view.tsx:487). No guard or caller appends the token beforehand (appendShareTokenToImageUrl is only used by the render-time resolver, share-image-url.ts:55, shared-document.tsx:907). Real and blocking: a new contract (URLs now require a per-viewer token) with an unupdated consumer on the primary path.
